lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 03:14. The night queue is dead quiet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then line three lights up.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: They took her. A girl — they just took her—

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: A van. Gray. No plates that I saw.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm at, a house on Calder's Street, Please I nee—

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Dead air.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Not a hang-up. A cut.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You play it back. Under her voice: an engine, idling.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Someone was waiting outside.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ping lands on Calder Street. Then the signal simply stops.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Phones don't do that on their own.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Calder Street. No unit assigned. No supervisor awake.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Just you and a dead line.

beats.prompt: The line just died. What do you do?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Against procedure. You dial anyway.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One ring. Two.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Straight to a dead tone — the line's been pulled.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You write the address down anyway. Calder Street.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You key the dispatch. By the book, every word.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A patrol turns toward Calder Street.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Police rushes in.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The house is dark. The van is already gone.
